chapter_title: Export Oriented Units (EOUs), Electronics Hardware Technology Parks (EHTPs), Software Technology Parks (STPs) and Bio-Technology
title: Fast Track Clearance Procedure

business_rules.rule_description:
6.39 Fast Track Clearance Procedure
a) Eligibility: EOUs having a status holder certificate under FTP shall
be eligible for Fast Track Clearance Procedure.
